metadata.title: Find the Animal That Resembles You 🐾 Fun Personality Test - What animal is inside you?
metadata.description: Find your hidden personality type through a fun animal personality test! 🐾 With highly accurate questions, learn about your traits and even discover compatibility with friends.

questions.question: Do you enjoy meeting new people?
What style of clothing do you prefer?
During your free time, what do you usually do?

options.text: Rest at home or do my hobbies

questions.question: When making difficult decisions, how do you usually act?

options.text: Trust my intuition and decide quickly
Carefully analyze all possibilities before deciding
Take my time to think slowly

questions.question: When you're under stress, how do you cope?

options.text: Actively try to solve the problem
Take time alone to organize my thoughts
Talk and vent to close people
Avoid it for now and think later

lion.name: Lion (Panthera leo)
lion.shortDescription: You are a natural-born leader with overwhelming charisma and unshakable conviction.
lion.fullDescription: As the 'King of Beasts,' the lion establishes order simply by its presence. As a Lion type, you are not a simple authoritarian, but a 'dignified pioneer' who clarifies the community's goals and inspires others to face difficulties. Your leadership stems from trust, not fear.

traits.0: Exceptional Initiative: You suggest directions without hesitation and lead the group even in complex situations.
traits.1: Strong Will: Once a goal is set, you have the energy to complete it regardless of any obstacles.
traits.2: Protection Instinct: You feel a strong responsibility to protect the people who trust and follow you.
traits.3: Straightforward Attitude: You stand out for your honesty, always proudly revealing your convictions without hiding anything.
traits.4: Presence: You exude a unique aura that gives a sense of stability and discipline to those around you even when you're silent.

biologicalContext.habitat: Lion primarily lives in the African savannah and prefers high places where they can overlook their territory.
biologicalContext.socialStructure: They form a unique social organization called a 'pride,' achieving high levels of cooperation and division of labor.
biologicalContext.survivalStrategy: Rather than acting alone, they use a strategic and systematic survival technique of maximizing the power of the group to hunt huge prey.
funFacts: A lion's roar can be heard up to 8km away, which is a 'declaration of order' to clarify territorial boundaries. Your words also provide powerful guidance to those around you.
It may seem like they're resting most of the day, but this is an expression of highly advanced self-management ability to concentrate all energy for the most important 'single strike'.

culturalHistory.orientalSymbolism: In the East, lion statues have been treated as spiritual creatures that protect palaces, symbolizing 'protection and prosperity' and chasing away bad luck.
culturalHistory.occidentalSymbolism: In Western heraldry, the lion is the highest symbol of 'courage' and 'royalty,' and has been engraved as a source of pride for numerous knights and royal families.
mythology: Nemean Lion: The first trial Hercules faced in Greek mythology, symbolizing a huge destiny and power that must be overcome.
Sekhmet: The Egyptian lion-headed goddess in charge of destruction and healing, meaning a ruthless power that protects justice.

personalGrowthDeepDive.leadershipStyle: Your leadership is 'Vision Sharing.' You make others move voluntarily by presenting a brilliant future rather than applying pressure.
personalGrowthDeepDive.socialDynamics: You are often located at the top of the social hierarchy, and you embody the noble spirit of 'Noblesse Oblige,' which is strong for the strong and generous for the weak.
personalGrowthDeepDive.careerPath: CEO, politician, project manager, commander, or an entrepreneur leading your own brand is most suitable.
personalGrowthDeepDive.relationshipAdvice: Your strong light can sometimes intimidate others. You will be able to build a more solid bond by listening to the small voices of the other person and showing your own vulnerabilities.

analysis.overview: The Lion type is a 'Guardian of Order' who brings order to chaos. You achieve true greatness not only by your own success but by pulling up the people around you.

strengths.0: Indomitable spirit that never breaks even in the face of adversity
strengths.1: Strong execution power that unites the collective in one direction
strengths.2: The magnanimity of always looking at the big picture without being shaken by trivial things

challenges.0: Risk of becoming dogmatic and causing resentment due to pride
challenges.1: Very strong pride makes it difficult to admit your own failures at times
challenges.2: Danger of neglecting small practical tasks and being buried only in huge plans

advice.0: Walk the 'Royal Road' of moving people with virtue, not power.
advice.1: Your roar is strong, but sometimes pay attention to the truth contained in silence.
advice.2: By praising the small growth of your subordinates, your 'empire' will become more solid.

lion.academicQuote: I am not afraid of an army of lions led by a sheep; I am afraid of an army of sheep led by a lion. - Alexander the Great

cat.name: Cat (Felis catus)
cat.shortDescription: You are a free explorer with an overflowing sense of independence, your own unique aesthetics, and a refined sensibility.
cat.fullDescription: The cat crosses boundaries and symbolizes a pure 'self' that is not bound by anyone. As a Cat type, you are a 'static philosopher' who follows your own inner voice without being colored by the logic of the group. Your keen sense is excellent at finding hidden beauty in everyday life.

traits.0: Firm Independence: You have the strength to walk the path you believe is necessary even if you are alone, without being swayed by the evaluation of those around you.
traits.1: Sharp Sensitivity: You intuitively capture subtle emotions hidden behind words or small changes in the environment.
traits.2: Thorough Self-Management: You know your limits and needs well, and you do not hesitate to rest for the balance of your mind and body.
traits.3: Secretive Charm: You don't reveal everything, and you have a mysterious side that opens your inner self only to special people.
traits.4: Refined Aesthetic Sense: You have an eye for 'real' values that do not change over time rather than cheap trends.

biologicalContext.habitat: They adapt anywhere but always secure a 'safe sanctuary' where personal privacy is protected.
biologicalContext.socialStructure: They don't feel the need to form a pack and maintain an equal sense of distance with others as an independent individual.
biologicalContext.survivalStrategy: Rather than overwhelming with force, they pursue an 'aesthetic of efficiency' by waiting for the right timing and getting the maximum results with the minimum power.
funFacts: A cat spends about two-thirds of its life sleeping. This symbolizes your deep time of contemplation and accumulation of energy for important decisions.
A cat's whiskers read the flow of air even in the dark to avoid obstacles. You also have an 'invisible antenna' to read the flow of energy around you.

culturalHistory.orientalSymbolism: In Japan, 'Maneki-neko' is a symbol of inviting good luck, and in many folktales, cats are often described as sages with magical powers.
culturalHistory.occidentalSymbolism: Cats were worshipped as sacred beings in ancient Egypt and were regarded as symbols of wisdom, mystery, and rebirth.
mythology: Bastet: The goddess who presides over peace and joy in the home, symbolizing both gentleness and bold aggressiveness to protect the house.
Cait Sith: A cat in Scottish legends that has its own kingdom and is very intelligent.

personalGrowthDeepDive.leadershipStyle: Your leadership is 'Leading by Example.' Rather than giving instructions one by one, you inspire others with the high completeness of your results.
personalGrowthDeepDive.socialDynamics: You don't feel the need to get close to everyone and prefer narrow and deep connections. A person who has gained your trust will become a lifelong companion.
personalGrowthDeepDive.careerPath: Artist, writer, engineer, researcher, or a freelancer with high expertise is most suitable for you.
personalGrowthDeepDive.relationshipAdvice: If you don't explain to the other person that you 'need time for freedom,' you can sometimes be misunderstood as being coldblooded. Just expressing gratitude in words will make the relationship much smoother.

analysis.overview: The Cat type is the 'last free man' of modern society. You prioritize being honest with yourself rather than meeting the expectations of others.

strengths.0: Strong self-identity and autonomy that is not shaken by external disturbances
strengths.1: Excellent intuition to see through the essence of things in an instant
strengths.2: Ability to pursue unique aesthetics and create unique values

challenges.0: A tendency to isolate yourself because you find cooperation with others cumbersome
challenges.1: Danger of applying your own standards to others and evaluating them strictly
challenges.2: Possibility of being reflected as a whimsical and difficult person due to lack of explanation

advice.0: Your solitude is a source of creation, but sometimes open the window and let in the wind of others.
advice.1: 'Empathy' is not bondage. Don't be afraid to resonate with others' emotions.
advice.2: Try sharing your aesthetics in words. An understander will appear and your world will become wider.

cat.academicQuote: Cats contain a philosophy to overcome unfortunate destinies. - Sakutaro Hagiwara

dog.name: Dog (Canis lupus familiaris)
dog.shortDescription: You are the guardian of deep sincerity and devoted friendship that brightly illuminates your surroundings.
dog.fullDescription: The dog is humanity's oldest and most loyal ally. As a Dog type, you regard ties with others as your lifeline and are an 'empathetic balancer' who values team unity above all else. Your presence warms cold organizations and gives people a sense of belonging and peace.

owl.name: Owl (Strigiformes)
owl.shortDescription: You are a sage who sees through the truth in the dark and predicts the future with cool intelligence.
owl.fullDescription: The owl has been a symbol of 'wisdom' and 'foreknowledge' since ancient times. As an Owl type, you are a 'logical observer' who extracts the essence from vast data without being swept away by the waves of emotion. Your words have weight and guide the right way forward by organizing chaos.

wolf.name: Wolf (Canis lupus)
wolf.shortDescription: You are the owner of sharp wild intuition and a cool yet hot will to lead the pack.
wolf.fullDescription: The wolf is a 'proud hunter' with high intelligence and wild persistence at the same time. As a Wolf type, your strength as an independent individual stands out, but at the same time you are a warrior with an extreme sense of responsibility for your 'pack' (family or team) even at the cost of self-sacrifice.

fox.name: Fox (Vulpes vulpes)
fox.shortDescription: You are a strategist with clever intelligence and versatile adaptability to creatively pioneer the future.
fox.fullDescription: The fox is a symbol of a 'trickster' who blurs boundaries and breaks stereotypes. As a Fox type, you are a 'practical innovator' who finds optimal solutions with humor and flexibility without being tied down by rigid rules.

panda.name: Panda (Ailuropoda melanoleuca)
panda.shortDescription: You are the owner of a peaceful mind and the 'embodiment of healing' who provides harmony and rest to your surroundings.
panda.fullDescription: The panda is a 'seeker of peace' who avoids struggle and values their own comfortable rhythm. As a Panda type, you know how to enjoy the small happiness of this moment without losing yourself even in the competitive modern society.

rabbit.name: Rabbit (Leporidae)
rabbit.shortDescription: You are a 'messenger of love' with delicate sensitivity and soft empathy that resonates with others' pain.
rabbit.fullDescription: The rabbit is a 'guardian of peace' who knows how to be careful about their surroundings and not break harmony. As a Rabbit type, you are a treasure of the community who knows how to intuitively read the atmosphere and say warm words to heal the wounded.

turtle.name: Turtle (Testudines)
turtle.shortDescription: You are a 'profound philosopher' with unshakable patience who reaches the truth over a long period of time.
turtle.fullDescription: The turtle is a 'symbol of persistence' that achieves final victory by moving forward one step at a time without being dazzled by the trends in front of you. As a Turtle type, you move in your own pace no matter how noisy the surroundings are and have a strong mental core that reaches depths no one else could reach.

eagle.name: Eagle (Accipitridae)
eagle.shortDescription: You are a 'noble leader' who overlooks the whole from high up and realizes ideals with sharp decision-making power.
eagle.fullDescription: The eagle is a 'symbol of perspective' that always looks at the big picture without being tied to the minor events of daily life. As an Eagle type, you are the 'ruler of the sky' with excellent strategic eyes that uphold noble ideals and see through the shortest and most effective way to reach them.

lion.compatible: You and the Wolf build a 'Symbiotic Empire.' The Lion's vision and the Wolf's strategic execution combine to create a powerful synergy that achieves community goals in the shortest time.
lion.incompatible: You and the Turtle may run on parallel lines due to differences in speed. The Turtle's cautiousness can feel like a frustrating 'stagnation' to you, making mutual respect essential.

cat.compatible: You and the Owl are a 'Solidarity of Solitary Philosophers.' While perfectly respecting each other's privacy, you are ideal partners who share spiritual rest through deep intellectual conversation.
cat.incompatible: You and the Dog may experience conflict due to an asymmetry of social needs. The Dog's constant affection can feel like an intrusion to you, necessitating healthy distance.

dog.compatible: You and the Rabbit create an 'Emotional Sanctuary.' Your dedicated support and the Rabbit's meticulous empathy blend together to form the warmest and safest relationship in the world.
dog.incompatible: You and the Cat may have different definitions of relationship. When your desire for 'togetherness' and the Cat's value of 'individuality' collide, deep patience is required.

owl.compatible: You and the Turtle share the value of 'Accumulating Wisdom.' Your logical analysis and the Turtle's long-term patience meet to build an unbreakable intellectual trust.
owl.incompatible: You and the Fox differ in the way you build trust. When your principle-centered thinking frictionizes with the Fox's flexible opportunism, there is a risk of mutual distrust.

wolf.compatible: You and the Lion are an 'Honorable Alliance.' Recognizing each other as equally strong, you clearly divide responsibilities and powers, showing the ultimate teamwork to break through any crisis together.
wolf.incompatible: You and the Rabbit have different masses of energy. Your rough and direct charisma can shrink the Rabbit's delicate emotions, necessitating soft communication skills.

fox.compatible: You and the Cat are 'Independent Strategists.' In a freedom that does not bind, you admire each other's ingenious ideas, becoming an interesting relationship that pursues both fun and efficiency.
fox.incompatible: You and the Eagle collide at the level of values. When the Eagle's grand cause and your practical flexibility don't match, it's easy to misunderstand each other as 'stubborn' or 'opportunistic.'

panda.compatible: You and the Turtle enjoy a 'Tranquility where Time seems to have Stopped.' It is the best match where you get perfect healing just by being together in a comfortable rhythm that no one rushes.
panda.incompatible: You and the Lion have different purposes of existence. Noise and stress can occur when the Lion's desire to achieve shakes your life of being content with simple pleasures.

rabbit.compatible: You and the Dog are in a 'Relationship like Warm Sunshine.' The Dog gently embraces your sensitivity, and you become emotional companions who transparently share each other's feelings.
rabbit.incompatible: You and the Wolf may be tense due to the overwhelming difference in aura. The Wolf's strong independence can feel like a cold rejection to you, necessitating delicate emotional confirmation.

turtle.compatible: You and the Owl are like 'Trees with Deep Roots.' Since both types explore truth without rushing, you form a dignified trust relationship that deepens as the years go by.
turtle.incompatible: You and the Lion collide in speed and splendor. Cracks in the relationship can occur when the Lion's immediate result-oriented attitude ignores your systematic process.

eagle.compatible: You and the Lion are a 'Celestial Leaders' union. Your grand vision and the Lion's practical leadership meet to succeed in massive projects that could change the world.
eagle.incompatible: You and the Fox frictionize due to methodological differences. When your noble cause meets the Fox's impromptu survival strategy, you may come to doubt each other's sincerity.
